ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense stochastic white mottling and speckling across both lobes; highest concentration of high-intensity pixel blobs is located at the distal tips and outer margins, with lower density surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; the lower vertex is partially occluded by water surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel amplitude increasing significantly toward the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and sub-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-8 pixel diameter) distributed across the dark pigment of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct diagonal linear pixel disruption (white on dark) approximately 1/3 lobe length in the lower inner quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity, multi-planar pixel masses (barnacles) are attached to the distal tips and leading edges of both fluke lobes.
